subject.title: fix(imessage): threaded replies are dropped when the Messages bridge stalls

question: Should a verified-undelivered threaded iMessage reply intentionally fall back to an unthreaded text send after a Messages bridge timeout?
rationale: The code preserves delivery and avoids blind retries, but it deliberately trades threaded placement for delivery under a bridge-specific failure mode; the protected maintainer label requires explicit human judgment.

options.title: Accept the guarded fallback
options.body: Treat an unthreaded reply as preferable to a dropped reply when the original send is proven not to have landed, after real after-fix evidence is added.

options.title: Preserve strict threading
options.body: Keep timing out threaded sends as failures and pursue a bridge-side repair instead if thread placement must never be lost.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded fallback
recommendation.body: Treat an unthreaded reply as preferable to a dropped reply when the original send is proven not to have landed, after real after-fix evidence is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the production incident analysis and the specific bridge behavior motivating the recovery choice.
